request.objective: Start at https://www.uniqlo.com/. Show me the list of Men's Blazers, Black, Size M on Uniqlo.

response.result:
I couldn't put together the list of Men's Blazers in Black, size M — the site never produced a filtered result set, so I have no product names or prices for you.

What I did get to: the Men's Blazers category page on Uniqlo US, and its filter panel. The panel covers Product Type (with Blazers listed, alongside a "Clear all"), Size, Color, Sleeve Length, Material, Special Collaboration, Price, Stock and Options, and at one point it showed a "VIEW ITEMS (3)" action — but I can't say what those three items were, or which selections that count was reflecting, so I won't present them as your answer.

What stopped it: the Size section wouldn't open. It stayed collapsed with no size choices rendered, and clicking it left the page unchanged every time. Black was never locked in either. Without both filters set, the site had nothing filtered to show.

If you want to retry, the more dependable route looks like loading the Blazers category with the filters carried in the URL rather than through the on-page filter panel, which is what appeared to be unresponsive.
